## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Financials and Technology show clear 1W strength with multiple large caps ABOVE TREND (JPM, V, MA and AAPL, GOOGL), while leadership is narrow with tech concentration (Leadership: Narrow — 3/5 Technology).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology lead with AAPL (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +8.62% | 1M: +2.14%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -8.94%) RECOVERY; Financials strong with JPM (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +6.25% | 1M: +14.36%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials showing follow-through with BA (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +11.38%) ABOVE TREND and GD (1W: +9.18% | 1M: +12.31%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Real Estate weak with AMT (1W: -7.68% | 1M: -10.20%) BELOW TREND, EQIX (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.26%) BELOW TREND and DLR (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -4.71%) BELOW TREND; Utilities under pressure with CEG (1W: -6.87% | 1M: -8.00%) BELOW TREND; Communication lagging via T (1W: -9.42% | 1M: -12.61%) BELOW TREND and VZ (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -9.82%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5 (SP100 focus): AAPL (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +10.55% | 1M: -0.93%) RECOVERY, IBM (1W: +10.27% | 1M: -2.00%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +9.09% | 1M: -3.55%) RECOVERY, GD (1W: +9.18% | 1M: +12.31%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: DLR (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -4.71%) BELOW TREND, TGT (1W: -10.18% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION, VZ (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -9.82%) BELOW TREND, RCL not in SP100 focus skipped, AMT (1W: -7.68% | 1M: -10.20%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Real Estate and select staples/communications.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Biggest 1W movers: AAPL (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +10.55% | 1M: -0.93%) RECOVERY, IBM (1W: +10.27% | 1M: -2.00%) RECOVERY, GD (1W: +9.18% | 1M: +12.31%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +9.09% | 1M: -3.55%) RECOVERY — note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple mega-caps (MSFT, NVDA, META and others) show 1W up vs 1M down, so watch for trend break despite RISK-ON.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is positive on the week (1W: +4.38% | 1M: -5.23%) with AAPL (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +8.62% | 1M: +2.14%) ABOVE TREND but several large caps in RECOVERY (NVDA (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -8.94%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +3.69% | 1M: -9.50%) RECOVERY) — mixed internals warrant selective exposure.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are leading on momentum (1W: +4.29% | 1M: +10.42%) with JPM (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +6.25% | 1M: +14.36%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND — breadth and multi-name strength confirm cyclical/value bias.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare modestly positive (1W: +0.31% | 1M: +8.69%) with JNJ (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +16.17%) ABOVE TREND while UNH (1W: -2.31% | 1M: +11.51%) CORRECTION and LLY (1W: -0.67% | 1M: +11.24%) CORRECTION show short-term pullbacks inside a longer uptrend.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and select Industrials as cyclical/value exposure (JPM (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +6.25% | 1M: +14.36%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +11.38%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to names showing 1W/1M divergence in Tech (MSFT (1W: +3.69% | 1M: -9.50%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -8.94%) RECOVERY). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt amid RISK-ON but monitor mega-cap divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: JPM (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND for earnings/sector momentum, AAPL (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND for continued tech flows. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: +3.69% | 1M: -9.50%) RECOVERY and NVDA (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -8.94%) RECOVERY — watch for failure to follow through.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Financials (1W: +4.29% | 1M: +10.42%) — breadth confirms leadership. BEARISH: Real Estate and Communication (Real Estate 1W: -2.92% | Communication 1W: -0.75%) — downside concentration may persist.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
AAPL support pivot near recent breakout levels (watch for continuation while ABOVE TREND), NVDA must hold short-term RECOVERY support or risk reversion to BELOW TREND, JPM breakout continuation level to confirm Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
SCHW (+80): Charles Schwab (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +16.20%) ABOVE TREND after stress-test and asset inflows — price confirms sentiment. PFE (+80): Pfizer (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -6.39%) BELOW TREND on FDA approval headline — sentiment bullish but price diverging (distribution risk). PLTR (+55): Palantir (1W: +17.36% | 1M: -6.79%) RECOVERY on AI/government news — monitor follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-85): Meta (1W: +9.09% | 1M: -3.55%) RECOVERY facing major legal headline — sentiment very bearish while price is rising (clear divergence). MSFT (-40): Microsoft (1W: +3.69% | 1M: -9.50%) RECOVERY after layoffs headline — negative sentiment vs short-term strength. BA (-50): Boeing (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +11.38%) ABOVE TREND despite outage news — watch execution risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Value/Cyclical tilt. JPM (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND and AAPL (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among mega-caps (MSFT, NVDA, META) and mixed news sentiment (PFE, META) — monitor for trend confirmation.
